query.text: 请帮我留意铲饲料时的工作状态，出现需要休息的迹象时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please monitor my condition while I shovel feed and remind me if you observe signs that I need a rest.

annotation.text_zh: 干活辛苦了，累了就停下歇会儿吧
annotation.text_en: You've been working hard, take a break if you're tired.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
